description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare that the Excise Duty on Hybrid Motor Cars be Payable according to the rate Specified in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1885/42 of 24.10.2014 w.e.f. 01.04.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with regulatory matters under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, specifically declaring changes to excise duty rates on hybrid motor cars. It contains a legal order issued by the Minister of Finance exercising powers vested by legislation, making it a regulatory/legal matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
